tickets.title: Run a durable bounded upgrade job through deterministic staging
tickets.delivers: Start and inspect one isolated release job through CLI/API/MCP; apply pinned patches, build/stage with existing primitives, preserve progress and cumulative budgets across restart, enforce owned-worker cancellation and disable fencing.
criteria: A fixture release reaches staged or a truthful failed/held state through all three public surfaces.
One-candidate, three-attempt, two-hour, two-compiler-job and 24 GiB limits are enforced and survive restart.
Unresolved conflicts are detected independently of command exit code; deterministic failure preserves selection.
Disable stops owned workers and fences later stages without affecting unrelated sessions.

tickets.title: Autonomously repair conflicting patches with independent behavioral review
tickets.delivers: A conflicting candidate invokes a bounded coding worker, obtains independently adjudicated review and returns a reviewed package candidate or a visible held result.
criteria: Rewrites and patch retirement require demonstrated behavioral equivalence; required capabilities cannot be waived.
Review binds candidate/test digests; subsequent changes invalidate affected approval.
Generated bindings, schema and lockfile changes are included in build qualification.
Rejected repairs and crashes consume the same job budget; no hidden fresh attempt.

tickets.title: Qualify exact candidates through disposable installed account and capability journeys

criteria: Immutable package/executable digests bind the qualification receipt.

Capabilities, session visibility, failure recovery and compatible rollback are exercised; teardown census records owned processes.

tickets.title: Promote qualified builds for future launches with compatible rollback
tickets.delivers: A configured opt-in scope automatically selects a qualifying candidate while active sessions remain pinned; the public interface exposes selection and rollback outcomes.
criteria: Revalidate enabled policy, scope, generations, review/qualification and package identity immediately before atomic selection.
Disable/promotion races and uncertain commit results reconcile without false claims or repeated effects.
Failed or incompatible candidates preserve the working build; incompatible rollback refuses without rewriting history.
No live daemon replacement or account migration is triggered.

tickets.title: Discover stable releases persistently and coalesce the upgrade queue
tickets.delivers: An opt-in persistent watcher creates deduplicated upgrade jobs and processes the newest stable release after the current bounded attempt.
criteria: Official provenance, stable-only filtering, lag and poll state are inspectable.
Repeated polling/restarts cannot reset a failed release budget or duplicate accepted work.
Newer releases coalesce predictably with retained skipped-release history.
Disable prevents discovery dispatch; reenable does not silently renew exhausted jobs.
